title: zehre dagha se waarise hyder hua shaheed
body:
zehre dagha se warise hyder hua shaheed
deene nabi ka saatwa rehbar hua shaheed
misle ali jo abide shab zinda daar tha
misle hassan wo qaasae daawar hua shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
tha jis ke lab pe qaid me bhi shukre kirdegaar
zindan me wo saabiro shaakir hua shaheed
ghaizo ghazab ka zehr piya jisne umr bhar
kazim laqab tha jiska wo sarwar hua shaheed
<<DIVIDER>>
faaqo ne kar diya tha jise laagharo naheef
aaqar wo bhook pyaas ka qoogar hua shaheed
